prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1129
Claimant:
Jeffrey Davenport
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
2025-01-15
First notice of loss reecived by phone from the claimant, who reports being rear-ended at a traffic light by another
vehicle and says they were taken to hospital with a head injury diagnosed as a concussion.
2025-03-16
Confirmed the claimant is the named driver on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of the collision.
Opened the file and assigned it for handling.
2025-04-08
Spoke with the claimant, who is not represented by a lawyer. They described the same sequence of events they gave
at first notice and said they were stopped and wearing a seatbelt when impact occurred.
2025-04-20
Obtained the police report. Officers at the scene recorded the claimant as a occupant in the vehicle and noted the
rear impact, with the other driver's account matching the claimant's.
2025-05-07
Took statements from two witnesses who saw the collision from the adjacent lane. Both describe the vehicle being
struck from behind in the way the claimant described.
2025-05-17
Received photographs of the vehicle from the claimant and a repair estimate from the body shop. The damage to the
rear is mostly consistent with the reported impact speed and direction.
2025-06-16
Inspected the vehicle with the shop's assessor. No prior damage was found, and no earlier repairs to the affected
areas appear in the vehicle history.
2025-06-24
Reviewed the claimant's medical records. The concussion diagnosis fits the kind and force of a rear impact of this
type. Treatment continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the treating provider noted follow-up
visits.
2025-06-29
Asked the claimant about any earlier injuries to the head or neck. The claimant reported none, and no proir injury to
the same body area appears in the records obtained so far.
2025-07-19
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the collision happened as the claimant described and acknowledged
responsibility for the rear impact.
2025-07-27
Confirmed with the claimant on a second call that the account has stayed the same across every conversation so far.
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start date.
2025-07-31
Reviewed the file summary. Liability appears clear, the vehicle damage is in line with the reported impact, and the
injury claim is proceeding to evaluation of medical treatment costs and lost time.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
